name: Vianney Lopez
reason: Her own site (vianneylopez.com, read 5 Nov 2026) presents Arts of Origin as a multidisciplinary creative studio (handmade clay instruments and altar objects, Native flute albums, illustration, RISO printing and animation); her teaching offers are craft and music lessons (clay instrument-making workshops, a Native flute course, private flute lessons), so this is an artist and music project rather than a spiritual teacher. She does have a contact form (vianneylopez.com/contact) but publishes no base; the owner may reconsider if ceremonial instrument-making is wanted.
